headerDisplay:
Turn the TV on and enable IP/remote control and network standby. For PIN pairing, leave **Pre-shared key** blank, save, and restart Homebridge (or the plugin's child bridge). Click the URL printed in [Homebridge Logs](/logs), then enter the PIN displayed on the TV in that page. Saved sessions and valid pre-shared keys skip PIN pairing.

Add each TV separately in Apple Home using Homebridge's pairing code.

ip.title: IP address or hostname
ip.description: TV address only, without http://, credentials, port, or path.

mac.title: MAC address
mac.description: Required for Wake-on-LAN when network standby does not wake the TV.

woladdress.title: Wake-on-LAN destination
woladdress.description: Broadcast IP address or hostname reachable from Homebridge.

tvsource.title: Preferred TV source
tvsource.description: Optional additional Sony source category to discover.

soundoutput.title: Audio output
soundoutput.description: Sony audio output target used for volume control.

updaterate.title: Status polling interval
updaterate.description: Milliseconds between status updates; must be positive.

channelupdaterate.title: Channel refresh interval
channelupdaterate.description: Milliseconds between channel list updates; 0 disables channel polling.

starttimeout.title: Startup timeout
starttimeout.description: Positive delay in milliseconds for the television to wake.

psk.title: Pre-shared key
psk.description: Optional key matching the TV's IP control settings. Leave blank for PIN pairing.

externalaccessory.title: Publish as external television
externalaccessory.description: Recommended: pair each TV separately in the Home app. Set false to publish through the bridge instead.

sources.title: Input sources
sources.description: New TVs start with the five default Sony source categories. Edit the list to customize discovery. Homebridge's form omits empty lists on save; to disable these categories, set sources to [] using JSON Config. At most 95 inputs and applications are exposed.

applications.title: Applications
applications.description: Add app titles or title substrings to expose matching installed TV apps as inputs. Delete entries to remove them; an empty list exposes no apps.
